layouts.name: Circuito San Juan Villicum
layouts.description: Draft full racing configuration using connected pinned OSM roads. Source alignment and timing remain estimated.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap connected course network
sources.evidenceNote: Exact public OSM ways and shared node IDs from the pinned extract. Racing-straight and corner branch selections are independently identified by the WorldSBK2021 map and native imagery.

sources.title: WorldSBK2021 San Juan Villicum circuit identity
sources.evidenceNote: Configuration identity only. Distinguishes the racing course from pit and long-lap penalty branches. No diagram coordinates, GPS table values or official distance are imported.

sources.title: Aerial imagery for estimated road borders
sources.evidenceNote: Derived edge coordinates. Source-specific extraction and derived-coordinate redistribution agreement confirmed by the dataset operator; agreement held separately. Image hashes, extents and extraction evidence are stored in the layout. Estimates remain unreviewed.
